title: Suraj Mal Meets the Sarbat Khalsa and Tribute Terms Are Fixed

blocks.text: The settlement scene is staged before the whole Panth rather than in private bargaining. Age khalse panth bahi sarabat lai divan, and when Suraj Mal comes forward sayam singh utth khaloyo, signaling both formal respect and the authority of the assembly.

The tribute is then fixed and the conversation shifts from diplomacy to allocation. Once money is promised, the Panth immediately begins debating whether it should be divided by misl strength, military contribution, or broader communal claim.

The page shows the confederacy thinking politically and institutionally at the same time. Victory is measured not only by tribute collected, but by how responsibly the common proceeds will be handled.
